decisions.reason: Having survived the early evaluation period and fitting closely with the firm’s established resin-injection and material-handling capabilities, this unit is likely seen as meeting aspiration levels well enough to retain unless replaced by a clearly superior successor.

As a manual airless spray gun in a core application category supported by the firm’s engineering, service and distributor network, it is likely to remain unless sales fall noticeably below aspiration relative to comparable spray-gun offerings.

Because this is a multi-model product line in one of the firm’s central spray-equipment segments, management is likely to view it as strategically important and adaptable, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
